title: Qabre Zehra pa ye kehne lagi rokar zainab
body:
QABR-E-ZEHRA PA YE KEHNE LAGI ROKAR ZAINAB
Tha mera laadla Akber jo muradon wala
Uske seene pa layenon ne hai naiza maara
Dekhti reh gaye Akber ko tadap kar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera Qasim nahi ab Aon-o-Mohammed bhi nahi
Bazu Abbas ke darya pa kahin lash kahin
Dagh-e-gham leke yahan aaye hai dil par Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Che(6) mahine ka mujahed Ali Asghar pyasa
Chid gaya khusk gala teer gale par jo laga
Yaad karti hai ose ashk baha kar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Asr-e-ashoor qayamat hi kuch aise aaye
Mera bhaye tahe khanjar tha badi ghurbat thi
Kaise bhulegi bhala hashr ke manzar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Har qadam aik museebat pa museebat chaye
Kufa-o-sham ke darbar se hokar aaye
Gaye bazaron mein be maqna-o-chadar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Taqte shahi pe to baitha tha layee’n wawaila
Sathsau(700) kursi nasheen bhi the wahin wawaila
Dekh kar roti thi majaye ka jab sar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar-e-darbar rasan basta khade the hum sab
Chadaren sar pa na thi zaqm laga dil pe ajab
Apne balon se gaye muh ko chupa kar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere khatbon ne kiya hashr ka samaa’n barpa
Muh chupaye jo layeen khud ka wahin baitha tha
Misl baba ke main goya thi ghazanfar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr ne pyasi Sakina ko tamache maare
The yatemon pe bade zulm-o-sitam ke saaye
Aaye hai sham ke zindaan mein kho kar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye jo goor-e-gharebaan ka mujawer tha ose
Touq-o-Zanjeer mein jagda tha layeenon ne jise
Laye hai sath faqat us ko bacha kar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Sath mein Fatema Zehra ke chali aaye hain Aur wahin apne bhare ghar ko yahan laaye hain
Majlise Shah mein Qasim hai jo ghar ghar Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aaye hai apne bhare ghar ko luta kar Zainab
